hazards.summary: PPC access disappears if companyGrants/membership are removed before folding each active grant into the global DepartmentRole role/isActive (tombstones must become revocations); launcher tile, session role and ppcCapability depend on them and the ordinary role PUT is 409-blocked.

Single-company fallback is fragile: it applies only while zero membership rows exist anywhere and exactly one Acc_Company exists; ~15 sole-company checks share the second premise. Any extra Acc_Company (IE demo creates 2; seed-budget-demo creates 'Demo Co') or the first PPC grant locks users out of Store, Costing, Sales, Spend/Intake, accounting imports.

Store legacy semantics: tenantFilter hides null-company rows (reachable via capability-gated ?scope=legacy) and assertSameTenant refuses them; dropping the filter makes them visible and actionable. Run backfills first.
styleOwnershipClause combines the company predicate with real business filters (isActive, non-terminal status, journey/enquiry spine); keep those when stripping company.
Marketing content plan uses SpCompanyMembership as its people directory and stores owner.membershipId; removal breaks owner assignment.
Accounting is a frontend contract: companyId in path/query/body on ~139 endpoints guarded by tallyCompanyIds; the company list itself is filtered by org ownership.
Test blast radius: ~180 files create SpCompanyMembership and ~115 send X-Costing-Company; large fixture migration.
Idempotency keys (Store and Costing) include companyId; keep it constant or live keys replay/collide.
serviceScope/serviceFilter callers throw without companyId (14+ service files); change atomically.

Unique indexes compound with companyId collide on drop (voucher numbers, ledger names, SpDocumentSequence, PO/GRN/MRF/StockCount numbers, RawItem SKU, Vendor GSTIN, singletons such as CostingPolicy/MarketingTrackingConfig, seeded IE/TNA/PPC libraries, MarketingConsent); demo rows must be purged/merged first and autoIndex is off in production.
CustomerAccountClaim embeds the company in its _id ('<company>:<customer>'); dropping requires re-keying and merging.
strict:'throw' schemas (Marketing, GravAiUsage): removing companyId from the schema before $unset on stored docs makes reads/saves throw.
Granting PPC creates SpCompanyMembership (making every other global role company-effective) and revoking never deactivates it; the 409 guard misses Acc_User, AccessDepartment grants, legacy roles.

Two isAdmin truths: DB-verified (requirePlatformAdmin, HR, Marketing, Store/Costing) vs token claim (requireDepartmentRole, requireApproval, Sales, IE, production/QC guards, department-team, developer, files); admin tile shown for apps (PPC, Merch, Board) that refuse admins.

Launcher vs API: tiles come from AccessDepartment grants while ~133 EmployeeAuth routers admit any employee and DepartmentRole grants never add tiles; tile removal is not revocation (7-day token role/deptSlug).
Acc_Company DELETE /:id exists; deleting the GRAV company would orphan all books.
Frontend: CompanyProvider imports an untracked companySelection.js (commit together); CompanyProvider fires before the accountant guard switches session.

The configured development database has no employees collection; 35 of 64 active DepartmentRole rows match no identity in the collections that exist. Identity-keyed migration and live-data parity are blocked until the employee source is established.

securityFindingsOutOfScope.summary: LEGACY_SECRETS (public repo literals) accepted for verification in every env; forged isAdmin tokens become owner in department-team, change-requests, developer console, files, HR (via admin email).
Employee passwords: phone number and Firstname@MMDDYYYY always accepted even after a password change; mobile app uses phone as username and password and overwrites the real hash.
Legacy collection fallback lets a deactivated or password-reset DeptUser sign in with the old legacy password.
Single shared JWT_SECRET without audience/type: customer tokens (phone-only /signin), vendor and app tokens verify in EmployeeAuth/AllEmployeeApp; CMS tokens accepted as customer.
EmployeeAuthMiddlewear (133 files) and SalesAuth never re-read DB: role/isAdmin valid 7 days after deactivation, grant loss, logout or password change.
/switch-department skips tv check for DeptUsers (revoked session re-mints); /logout revokes only cookie tokens.
Face sign-in issues a 7-day session without isActive check; header comment wrongly says it issues none.
CMS forgot-password 4-digit OTP: attempts reset on every re-request, no cooldown, email enumeration; _devOtp returned when NODE_ENV unset (also CoWork and customer OTPs).
Barcode device API fully unauthenticated including OTA firmware upload with path traversal; inline production scan/sync routes unauthenticated.
change-password does not require currentPassword; mobile app $or status check admits inactive records; ACCOUNTANT_AUTH_BYPASS has no production guard.
Google Workspace routes: all 41 unauthenticated (refresh_token, any user's Gmail via domain delegation, calendar, drive, chat).
Unauthenticated POST /cowork/setup/seed-ceo sets Firebase ceo claim and overwrites E000 (CoWork CEO takeover); /employee/dump leaks tempPassword; /media/view streams any Drive file.
Field tracking CMS reads/deletes unauthenticated (employee GPS); call recorder/field device checkApiKey open when env unset.
Customer edit-request approve/reject routes unauthenticated.
departmentWriteGuard holes: READ_SHAPED substring skips role+approval on real writes; exempt matched against originalUrl including query string; fail-open when a department has no role rows.
/api/accountant/auth/sync-legacy auto-creates an owner Acc_User from an Acc_Department row (and leaks decodedKeys); /debug-token unauthenticated echo; /bootstrap while 0 orgs.
Socket.io accepts anonymous sockets that can join DM/group/employee/MRF/work-order rooms.
opsControls and AllEmployeeApp intern check fail open; WhatsApp webhook signature check fails open when no app secret set.
Accidental /api/cms EmployeeAuth floor from operations.js:28 (server.js:1483): unauthenticated routers rely on it and intended-public webhooks are probably blocked.
Legacy Store routes and inventory configuration: any employee can approve work orders, create/delete POs, edit BOM/stock items, operations and machines.
QC inspections recorded with inspector identity taken from request body; any employee token can record as anyone.
Hard-coded fallback secrets at ~30 call sites when JWT_SECRET unset; dev fallback secret when NODE_ENV≠production.
